title: Queen against an advanced pawn

D0.outcome: Explains that a queen normally beats a far-advanced pawn, and that stalemate rescues a rook or bishop pawn on the seventh when the stronger king is far.

D1.outcome: Classifies queen-against-pawn positions as win or draw, with the pawn's file and the king distances.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, finds the drawing stalemate resource for the weaker side and the winning approach for the stronger side.

D3.outcome: Verifies a classification with the tablebase and predicts how one king step changes it.

sources: docs/curriculum-map-v1.1.md §4 (backlog: Q vs rook; queen vs pawn not yet run)
conditions: The pawn is on the seventh with the weaker king near the queening square and the stronger king far away.
contrasts: A rook or bishop pawn on the seventh draws by stalemate when the stronger king is far, while a knight pawn loses.
A pawn not yet near the seventh.
